trends.name: April Coffee Drops New Manual Grinder
trends.buzz: April Coffee just launched a manual grinder into production. Known for their thoughtful brew gear, this could be a game-changer for portable, precision grinding at home or on the go.
trends.angle: Perfect for pour-over fans who want café-quality grinds anywhere. Manual grinders are having a moment, and April's design philosophy makes specialty approachable for everyone.

trends.name: How Filter Coffee Became Specialty's Favourite
trends.buzz: Filter coffee has officially become the drink of choice in specialty cafés worldwide. Pour-overs, batch brews, and drip methods are now the stars of the menu, not just espresso's sidekick.
trends.angle: This is our love language. Filter coffee celebrates the bean, the brewer, and the ritual. It's approachable, delicious, and puts pour-over front and center where it belongs.

trends.name: How to Curate an Exceptional Home Coffee Setup
trends.buzz: A fresh guide to building your dream home coffee station. From choosing the right brewer to pairing it with grinders, kettles, and beans that work together beautifully.
trends.angle: No gatekeeping here — just practical advice to help anyone build a setup that makes great coffee and feels good to use. Same team, better mornings.

trends.name: MiiR Launches First Ceramic Collection
trends.buzz: MiiR, beloved for their insulated drinkware, just dropped their first-ever line of handcrafted ceramics. Beautiful, functional pieces designed for coffee lovers who care about craft.
trends.angle: Gear that feels as good as it looks. MiiR's move into ceramics means more thoughtfully designed tools for your daily ritual — no snobbery, just beautiful coffee moments.

trends.name: Specialty Coffee Pops Up in Transit Hubs
trends.buzz: Train stations and transit hubs are becoming surprise hotspots for specialty coffee kiosks. No more settling for bad airport coffee — quality pour-overs are coming to the commute.
trends.angle: Coffee shouldn't require a detour. Bringing specialty to where people actually are makes great coffee more accessible, not more exclusive. We're here for it.

trends.name: What Makes a Truly Excellent Coffee Shop?
trends.buzz: A deep dive into what separates great cafés from unforgettable ones. Spoiler: it's not just the beans or the brewer — it's the whole vibe, the people, and the welcome.
trends.angle: Specialty should feel like home, not a test. The best shops make you feel like you belong, whether it's your first pour-over or your thousandth.

trends.name: Meet the New US AeroPress Champion
trends.buzz: The 2026 US AeroPress Championship crowned a new champ. Creative recipes, approachable techniques, and a reminder that great coffee doesn't require a $3,000 espresso machine.
trends.angle: AeroPress proves specialty coffee is for everyone. It's fun, affordable, and endlessly creative. Competitions like this celebrate skill without the snob factor.

trends.name: Coffee's Heart Health Benefits Shine Without Sugar
trends.buzz: New research shows coffee's heart health perks are strongest when you skip the sweeteners. Black coffee drinkers, this one's for you.
trends.angle: Good news for pour-over purists and anyone learning to taste coffee on its own terms. Health benefits are a bonus — but flavor is the real reward.

trends.name: Is Gesha Losing Its Grip on Coffee Competitions?
trends.buzz: Gesha's once-dominant reign in coffee competitions might be shifting. New varieties and unexpected origins are stealing the spotlight — and we're here for the diversity.
trends.angle: More variety means more discovery. Specialty thrives when we celebrate all great coffees, not just the usual suspects. Let's explore together.

trends.name: Robusta Might Not Be Climate's Silver Bullet After All
trends.buzz: A new study challenges the idea that robusta coffee can simply replace arabica as temperatures rise. Turns out the 'internet myth' oversimplified a complex climate problem.
trends.angle: Climate solutions need nuance, not shortcuts. Understanding the real challenges helps us support sustainable farming and better beans for everyone's future.

trends.name: Why the Protein Coffee Boom Won't Last
trends.buzz: Protein coffee exploded in popularity, but industry insiders predict the trend is already fading. Turns out, not every mashup has staying power.
trends.angle: Coffee is already perfect — it doesn't need to be everything at once. Let's focus on what makes coffee coffee: flavor, ritual, and great brewing.

trends.name: Graffeo Giving Away Ferrari with Espresso Machine in Engine
trends.buzz: Yes, you read that right. Graffeo is giving away a Ferrari — with an espresso machine built into the engine bay. The most ridiculous, delightful coffee giveaway ever.
trends.angle: Pure coffee joy. Sometimes specialty needs to be fun, weird, and totally over-the-top. This is the energy we love.
